We got his photo done at home using the app. It was a little dark, but they Photoshopped it so it was clear and precise, exactly like a passport photo. We received the ePhotos within 24 hours and a few days later received the actual ones in the post. I didn't need them, but just in case. This is the first time I've used an app that does exactly what it says with no problems! Well done, Smart photo!!!

It took a few attempts to get the photo approved, but it has tips on what to do differently. Both myself and my husband used this app to get new passports, and our photos were accepted first time by the passport office. Much cheaper than using a photo booth.

The staff verifies the photo is usable, and you can either have it posted or emailed to you. I didn't even have to leave the comfort of my own home, which is an added bonus. Definitely recommend!!

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
You must keep:

  • A plain expression and your mouth closed.
  • Your eyes open and visible.
  • Not have hair in front of your eyes.
  • Not have any shadows on your face or behind you.
  • Face the camera.
  • Your face should be fully visible and evenly lit.
  • Head coverings aren’t permitted unless for religious or medical reasons.

Your photo must be:

  • A printed photo must be 45*35 mm, printed on professional paper.
  • A digital photo must be clear and in focus, in color, and at least 600 * 750 pixels,50KB and no more than 10MB.
